label: rejected

evidence.V1: Top view and three-quarter read clearly as an L corner with quoins; front reads as a wall face.
evidence.V2: Big L mass and cap/plinth read, but the quoins are split into thin double slivers on alternate courses, muddying the medium level.
evidence.V3: Blocky courses with fussy thin quoin slivers; stiff rather than confident.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on courses, quoins, cap and plinth.
evidence.V5: Quoins flat close-up shows small triangular spikes poking out where stones meet at the corner; an off-hue sliver appears at the inner end of the far arm in three-quarter and colourway renders.
evidence.V6: Stone greys in ~3 values with darker plinth - disciplined; brick/sandstone colourways consistent.
evidence.V7: 732 tris vs module target 800 - under target.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material, stone hue, matching chamfer size with straight wall pieces.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, Color white, grid-corner pivot; T1 ends-equal tiling passes (iou 0.97).

evidence.V1: Top view reads clearly as an L corner and the front/three-quarter read as masonry, but the 3/4 silhouette is a plain slab with tiny course notches - the corner is not identifiable from outline alone.
evidence.V2: Big L mass, medium courses with quoin pairs, plinth and cap; no small-scale detail beyond the chamfers, so hierarchy is only partial.
evidence.V3: Chunky chamfered blocks fit the kit but the layout is a stiff rectangular grid; quoins alternate one wide / two narrow blocks and do not wrap convincingly around the outer arris; the butt end is a blank slab.
evidence.V4: Every stone, cap and plinth block carries the same ~0.06 stud chamfer that catches a highlight in the studio close-ups (end_x, quoins).
evidence.V5: Studio close-ups clean: no pinches, z-fighting or stray faceting; the dark V notches at the edge in quoins_flat are the designed mortar recesses between blocks.
evidence.V6: One stone hue in three values (light quoins/caps, mid field, dark plinth); colourways (brick, sandstone) keep the same value structure.
evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor white material, chamfered stone blocks, stone hue only - consistent with modular kit spec.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, CollisionFidelity Box, CanTouch off, Color white, SmoothPlastic, pivot at grid corner; T1 tiling pass (iou 0.97).

evidence.V1: The L footprint reads from the top view, but the silhouette and three-quarter outline are just a tall block; from the front it reads as a plain wall strip rather than a corner.
evidence.V2: Big L body and cap ledge plus block coursing, but no small tier; quoins are just narrow split strips that do not read as a distinct medium feature.
evidence.V3: Stiff and regular: uniform rectangular blocks, thin cap, quoin pattern of a narrow block beside a half-width strip looks accidental rather than stylised.
evidence.V4: Consistent small chamfers on every block and the cap ledge, catching light in the corner and end close-ups.
evidence.V5: Quoins flat close-up shows small dark spiky slivers at block junctions (stray geometry/gaps between shells), and a brown sliver is visible at the inner corner under the cap in the three-quarter view.
evidence.V6: Stone grey in about 3 values with a darker plinth course; brick and basalt colourways keep the structure.
evidence.V7: 732 tris vs module target 800, under target.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material and kit chamfers, but end sections are plain undressed dark slab faces and the inner-corner sliver shows an off-palette brown.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct for a modular piece (anchored, Box collision, CanTouch off, white colour, grid-corner pivot); T1 tiling pass with iou 0.973.

artifacts: Triangular spikes at stone corners in quoin close-up
Off-hue sliver at inner end of far arm
Small off-colour (cream/tan) sliver visible at the inner corner top in the three-quarter view, reads as an unintended strip rather than designed plaster
small dark spiky slivers at quoin block junctions (quoins flat close-up)
brown/tan sliver visible at the inner corner beneath the cap ledge (three-quarter and colourway renders)
top_fixes: Remove the stray spike geometry at quoin stone corners
Use single alternating long/short quoins instead of split slivers
Fix the off-colour face at the far arm's inner end so it follows the colourway
Make the quoins read as true alternating long/short stones wrapping both faces of the outer corner so the corner identity reads at 64 px
Break the rigid block grid with a few varied stone sizes / slight bevel offsets and add a small accent (e.g. a gold band or keystone) to give a small-scale tier
Resolve or colour-match the cream sliver at the inner top corner
Fix the inner-corner and quoin junction slivers so blocks meet cleanly (no gaps or poking shells)
Make proper alternating long/short quoin blocks that wrap the outer corner and project slightly so the corner reads in silhouette
Dress the end sections with block returns and vary block sizes for a more stylised read
